name: Spain national open data catalog
purpose: Discover dataset metadata and distribution links across publishers; does not return the underlying dataset rows.
notes: Official API documentation: https://datos.gob.es/es/accessible-apidata . Catalog pagination uses _page and _pageSize (maximum 50).

name: FEMP local open data directory
purpose: Discover municipal portal and dataset leads; directory membership is not a guarantee of live downloads.

name: INE JSON API documentation
purpose: Fetch observation data from INE tables; unlike catalog APIs, DATOS_TABLA returns statistical series.
notes: Use SERIES_TABLA / metadata to discover filter values; do not invent municipality codes or variable identifiers.

name: CKAN API documentation
purpose: Understand metadata discovery versus record retrieval.
notes: package_search/package_show return metadata; datastore_search returns records only for resources with DataStore support. A CKAN portal does not guarantee every resource has a queryable table.

name: Zaragoza REST API
purpose: Documented data endpoints with JSON, CSV and GeoJSON response formats.
notes: The api_url here is catalog metadata. Use dataset endpoints in the Datasets table for actual observations.

name: Madrid regional transport portal (CRTM)
purpose: Additional transport discovery lead for Madrid-region municipalities.
notes: Portal observed, but specific transport exports were not verified. Not counted as a dataset in this catalog.

name: Granada provincial catalog
purpose: Additional provincial tourism, geography and statistics discovery lead.
notes: CSV and GeoJSON examples appear in the catalog. Municipality-level applicability and export payloads were not checked; not counted as a dataset.
